title: Final Fantasy X: The Sending
alt: At sunset a young woman dances on top of a column of water that rises from the sea. She holds a long staff over her head, and the long pink and white sleeves of her dress fly out. Small lights with tails rise round her into the sky. Houses on posts, broken walks, torches and small figures are at each side, and palm fronds hang in from the top corners.
summary: A painting of the Sending at Kilika from Final Fantasy X in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the Sending at Kilika, from Final Fantasy X, a game by Square. Sin has broken the port and killed many of its people. A summoner must send the dead, or they become fiends.

Yuna dances on the water at sunset. The sea lifts her, and the dead leave the water as pyreflies. The people of Kilika watch from the walks, and her guardians are with them on the left. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
